test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. '**outnumbering**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The completion of the sentence suggests a comparison of the frequency of various animals depicted in the cave paintings.
 
• "**Outnumbering**"(अधिक संख्या में होना) means to be greater in number, which accurately describes how images of horses are more numerous compared to images of all other animals in these paintings. 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**outnumbering**'.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• "Outsourcing" is irrelevant in this context as it refers to obtaining goods or services from an outside or external source, a concept unrelated to the depiction of animals or any number comparison in art.(किसी बाहरी या बाहरी स्रोत से सामान या सेवाएँ प्राप्त करना)
 
• "Outlasting"(जीवित रहना.) implies surviving or continuing to exist for a longer period than something else, which doesn't apply to comparing quantities in the context of ancient paintings.
 
• "Outreaching" (किसी चीज़ से आगे बढ़ना) could imply extending beyond something, but it doesn't suitably apply to the numerical comparison of depicted animals in this scenario.

**Complete Passage is:** When another old cave is discovered in the south of France, it is not (1) ***usually ***in news. Rather, it is an ordinary event. Such discoveries are so (2) ***frequent ***these days that hardly anybody pays heed to them. However, when the Lascaux cave complex was discovered in 1940, the world was (3) ***baffled***. Painted directly on its walls were hundreds of scenes showing how people lived thousands of years ago. The scenes show people hunting animals, such as bison or wild cats. Other images (4) ***depict ***birds and, most noticeably, horses, which appear in more than 300 wall images, by far (5) *outnumbering*__* *all other animals.

21d:T942,

The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. '**Non-involvement**'.
